mapper.insert: INSERT INTO consultation_queue ( student_id, first_visit_result_id, problem_type_id, crisis_level, priority_score, queue_status, enqueue_time, create_time ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{firstVisitResultId}, #{problemTypeId}, #{crisisLevel}, #{priorityScore}, #{queueStatus}, #{enqueueTime}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE consultation_queue SET queue_status = #{queueStatus}, assigned_time = #{assignedTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

sql.if: AND (su.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR sp.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR pt.type_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT cq.id, cq.student_id, su.real_name AS student_name, sp.student_no, sp.college, COALESCE(sp.contact_phone, su.phone) AS phone, cq.problem_type_id, pt.type_name AS problem_type_name, cq.crisis_level, cq.priority_score, cq.enqueue_time, cq.queue_status, fvr.summary, fvr.next_action FROM consultation_queue cq LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cq.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN problem_type pt ON cq.problem_type_id = pt.id LEFT JOIN first_visit_result fvr ON cq.first_visit_result_id = fvr.id WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY cq.priority_score DESC, cq.enqueue_time ASC LIMIT #{query.pageSize} OFFSET ${(query.pageNum - 1) * query.pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consultation_queue cq LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cq.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN problem_type pt ON cq.problem_type_id = pt.id WHERE 1=1

SELECT cq.id, cq.student_id, su.real_name AS student_name, sp.student_no, sp.college, COALESCE(sp.contact_phone, su.phone) AS phone, sp.gender, cq.problem_type_id, pt.type_name AS problem_type_name, cq.crisis_level, cq.priority_score, cq.queue_status, cq.enqueue_time, cq.first_visit_result_id, fva.id AS appointment_id, fva.appointment_no, fvf.main_problem, fvf.problem_description, fvf.expected_help, fvf.risk_score, fvf.risk_level, fvr.interview_time, interviewer_su.real_name AS interviewer_name, fvr.summary, fvr.next_action FROM consultation_queue cq LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON cq.student_id = su.id LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON su.id = sp.user_id LEFT JOIN problem_type pt ON cq.problem_type_id = pt.id LEFT JOIN first_visit_result fvr ON cq.first_visit_result_id = fvr.id LEFT JOIN first_visit_appointment fva ON fvr.appointment_id = fva.id LEFT JOIN first_visit_form fvf ON fva.form_id = fvf.id LEFT JOIN staff_profile isp ON fvr.interviewer_id = isp.id LEFT JOIN sys_user interviewer_su ON isp.user_id = interviewer_su.id WHERE cq.id = #{id}
